reason: SideSight is a CLI-first media analysis tool for text-only coding agents, providing image, diagram, chart, UI diff, video, and OCR analysis through configured multimodal providers or explicit local macOS OCR.

summaries.zh: SideSight 为文本型编码智能体提供命令行媒体分析，可处理截图、图表、界面差异、视频和 OCR，并支持配置多模态服务或在 macOS 上执行本地 OCR。
summaries.en: SideSight provides CLI-based media analysis for text-only coding agents, covering screenshots, diagrams, charts, UI differences, videos, and OCR through configured multimodal services or explicit local macOS OCR.

capabilities: Reads specified local image and video files for analysis
Sends media to a configured multimodal provider for cloud-backed analysis
Performs explicit local OCR on macOS using Apple Vision
Exposes CLI and optional MCP interfaces
